blocks.html_en: Central to this proposal was a virtual unknown in the world of American defense: Repkon. The company had been operating in its home country of Turkey for decades, providing “turnkey production facilities in the metal forming industry.” (Coincidentally, Gezen himself was born to Turkish parents in the United States.)

sentences.en: Central to this proposal was a virtual unknown in the world of American defense: Repkon.
sentences.zh: 这一提议的核心是美国国防界一个几乎不知名的人：雷普康。

sentences.en: The company had been operating in its home country of Turkey for decades, providing “turnkey production facilities in the metal forming industry.”
sentences.zh: 该公司已在其祖国土耳其运营数十年，提供“金属成型行业的交钥匙生产设施”。

sentences.en: (Coincidentally, Gezen himself was born to Turkish parents in the United States.)
sentences.zh: （巧合的是，格曾本人出生在美国，父母是土耳其人。）

blocks.html_en: But Repkon had never received a Pentagon contract, and certainly not for its signature metalworking process called “flow-forming.” Whereas the Scranton method mainly involves molding ultrahot steel in giant forging presses, Repkon added a step in which a fast-spinning machine squeezes and rolls out the metal like clay on a potter’s wheel. The advantage, Gezen told defense officials, is that the same equipment could produce shells of various calibers. Most important, Repkon had a production line already available, meaning General Dynamics could start making shells faster than if it had to procure traditional equipment piece by piece.

sentences.en: But Repkon had never received a Pentagon contract, and certainly not for its signature metalworking process called “flow-forming.”
sentences.zh: 但雷普康从未收到过五角大楼的合同，当然也没有收到过其标志性金属加工工艺“旋压成型”的合同。

sentences.en: Whereas the Scranton method mainly involves molding ultrahot steel in giant forging presses, Repkon added a step in which a fast-spinning machine squeezes and rolls out the metal like clay on a potter’s wheel.
sentences.zh: 斯克兰顿方法主要涉及在巨型锻压机中模制超热钢，而雷普康则增加了一个步骤，其中快速旋转机器将金属像陶轮上的粘土一样挤压和滚压出来。

sentences.en: The advantage, Gezen told defense officials, is that the same equipment could produce shells of various calibers.
sentences.zh: 格曾告诉国防官员，其优点是相同的设备可以生产不同口径的炮弹。

sentences.en: Most important, Repkon had a production line already available, meaning General Dynamics could start making shells faster than if it had to procure traditional equipment piece by piece.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，雷普康已经拥有一条可用的生产线，这意味着通用动力公司可以比逐件采购传统设备更快地开始制造炮弹。

blocks.html_en: Warning signs abounded. Army officials learned that the production line that Repkon wanted to sell had been designed to produce an older, simpler model of 155 mm shells, which was made with different steel. It wasn’t clear that the Turkish equipment could even work with the steel used to make the newer 155 mm model, as the equipment had never actually produced it, according to four former General Dynamics and Army officials. Repkon said other countries were using the machines to produce the older model. But the Army and General Dynamics could not inspect those active production lines, Repkon told them, citing customer privacy.

sentences.en: Warning signs abounded.
sentences.zh: 警告信号比比皆是。

sentences.en: Army officials learned that the production line that Repkon wanted to sell had been designed to produce an older, simpler model of 155 mm shells, which was made with different steel.
sentences.zh: 陆军官员了解到，雷普康想要出售的生产线旨在生产一种较旧、较简单的 155 毫米炮弹型号，该炮弹由不同的钢材制成。

sentences.en: It wasn’t clear that the Turkish equipment could even work with the steel used to make the newer 155 mm model, as the equipment had never actually produced it, according to four former General Dynamics and Army officials.
sentences.zh: 据四名前通用动力公司和陆军官员称，目前还不清楚土耳其设备是否可以与用于制造新型 155 毫米型号的钢材配合使用，因为该设备从未实际生产过这种型号。

sentences.en: Repkon said other countries were using the machines to produce the older model.
sentences.zh: 雷普孔表示，其他国家正在使用这些机器来生产旧型号。

sentences.en: But the Army and General Dynamics could not inspect those active production lines, Repkon told them, citing customer privacy.
sentences.zh: 但雷普康以客户隐私为由告诉他们，陆军和通用动力公司无法检查这些活跃的生产线。

blocks.html_en: The Army could have balked at all of this and insisted on learning more about the capacity of the Repkon machines to perform the desired work. But learning more would’ve taken time, and time seemed in short supply. “There was incredible pressure to go fast,” a former Army official said. Everybody moved forward.

sentences.en: The Army could have balked at all of this and insisted on learning more about the capacity of the Repkon machines to perform the desired work.
sentences.zh: 陆军本可以对这一切犹豫不决，并坚持更多地了解雷普康机器执行所需工作的能力。

sentences.en: But learning more would’ve taken time, and time seemed in short supply.
sentences.zh: 但学习更多内容需要时间，而时间似乎很紧张。

sentences.en: “There was incredible pressure to go fast,” a former Army official said.
sentences.zh: 一位前陆军官员表示：“快速行动面临着令人难以置信的压力。”

sentences.en: Everybody moved forward.
sentences.zh: 大家都向前迈进了。

blocks.html_en: In November 2022, the Army raced to give General Dynamics the first in a series of contract awards for the project that would ultimately be worth nearly $600 million if carried to completion. The next month, Congress granted the DOD extraordinary powers to award money for Ukraine-related causes without the usual contracting safeguards, dropping competitive bidding requirements and restrictions on so-called undefinitized contracting actions. UCAs allow a company to begin work even before finalizing the terms of its contract with the government. One defense executive compared them to “building the airplane as you’re flying it.”

sentences.en: In November 2022, the Army raced to give General Dynamics the first in a series of contract awards for the project that would ultimately be worth nearly $600 million if carried to completion.
sentences.zh: 2022 年 11 月，陆军竞相向通用动力公司授予了该项目一系列合同中的第一个合同，如果完成，该项目最终价值近 6 亿美元。

sentences.en: The next month, Congress granted the DOD extraordinary powers to award money for Ukraine-related causes without the usual contracting safeguards, dropping competitive bidding requirements and restrictions on so-called undefinitized contracting actions.
sentences.zh: 下个月，国会授予国防部非凡权力，可以在没有通常的合同保障措施的情况下为与乌克兰相关的事业提供资金，从而放弃了竞争性招标要求和对所谓的未明确合同行动的限制。

sentences.en: UCAs allow a company to begin work even before finalizing the terms of its contract with the government.
sentences.zh: UCA 允许公司在与政府最终确定合同条款之前就开始工作。

sentences.en: One defense executive compared them to “building the airplane as you’re flying it.”
sentences.zh: 一位国防高管将它们比作“在驾驶飞机时建造飞机”。

blocks.html_en: The Army made the most of its expanded powers, awarding General Dynamics a number of UCAs without considering alternate proposals in a competitive bidding process. (The Army told ProPublica it selected the company because of its unique artillery production experience.)

sentences.en: The Army made the most of its expanded powers, awarding General Dynamics a number of UCAs without considering alternate proposals in a competitive bidding process.
sentences.zh: 陆军充分利用其扩大的权力，向通用动力公司授予了一些 UCA，而没有在竞标过程中考虑替代提案。

sentences.en: (The Army told ProPublica it selected the company because of its unique artillery production experience.)
sentences.zh: （陆军告诉 ProPublica，之所以选择该公司是因为其独特的火炮生产经验。）

blocks.html_en: In fact, the Army was so enamored with the proposal that it decided to order even more than Gezen had pitched. Instead of contracting for one Repkon production line, the Army signed up to buy three. Without knowing whether any of them would work.

sentences.en: In fact, the Army was so enamored with the proposal that it decided to order even more than Gezen had pitched.
sentences.zh: 事实上，陆军对该提案非常着迷，以至于决定订购比格曾提出的数量还要多的订单。

sentences.en: Instead of contracting for one Repkon production line, the Army signed up to buy three.
sentences.zh: 陆军没有签约购买一条雷普康生产线，而是购买了三条。

sentences.en: Without knowing whether any of them would work.
sentences.zh: 不知道其中任何一个是否有效。

blocks.html_en: Gezen had never overseen a project this ambitious. Until then, he had mainly presided over smaller expansions of existing factories that used traditional methods. But he was optimistic it would work. “He’s extremely aggressive, willing to take risks,” one former colleague said.

sentences.en: Gezen had never overseen a project this ambitious.
sentences.zh: 格曾从未监督过如此雄心勃勃的项目。

sentences.en: Until then, he had mainly presided over smaller expansions of existing factories that used traditional methods.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，他主要主持使用传统方法对现有工厂进行较小规模的扩建。

sentences.en: But he was optimistic it would work.
sentences.zh: 但他乐观地认为这会奏效。

sentences.en: “He’s extremely aggressive, willing to take risks,” one former colleague said.
sentences.zh: “他非常有进取心，愿意承担风险，”一位前同事说。

blocks.html_en: Some of the Army’s scrutiny of the proposal occurred only after it began awarding contracts for it. The service and General Dynamics sent staffers to Turkey to inspect Repkon’s machinery, but they never inspected a full production line in action and there weren’t enough experts who could spot potential defects in the equipment, four former General Dynamics and Army officials said. Crucially, before greenlighting the deal, the Army did not require General Dynamics to demonstrate that it could use the Repkon equipment to complete the entire production process and make shells that met the Army’s specifications. (The Army told ProPublica that “formal testing could not occur prior to full machinery installation.”)

sentences.en: Some of the Army’s scrutiny of the proposal occurred only after it began awarding contracts for it.
sentences.zh: 陆军对该提案的部分审查是在开始授予合同后才进行的。

sentences.en: The service and General Dynamics sent staffers to Turkey to inspect Repkon’s machinery, but they never inspected a full production line in action and there weren’t enough experts who could spot potential defects in the equipment, four former General Dynamics and Army officials said.
sentences.zh: 四名前通用动力公司和陆军官员表示，军方和通用动力公司派出工作人员前往土耳其检查雷普康的机器，但他们从未检查过整条运行中的生产线，也没有足够的专家能够发现设备中的潜在缺陷。

sentences.en: Crucially, before greenlighting the deal, the Army did not require General Dynamics to demonstrate that it could use the Repkon equipment to complete the entire production process and make shells that met the Army’s specifications.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，在批准这笔交易之前，陆军并没有要求通用动力公司证明它可以使用 Repkon 设备来完成整个生产过程并制造符合陆军规格的炮弹。

sentences.en: (The Army told ProPublica that “formal testing could not occur prior to full machinery installation.”)
sentences.zh: （陆军告诉 ProPublica，“在完整的机械安装之前无法进行正式测试。”）

blocks.html_en: If the typical contracting safeguards had been in place, perhaps everything that followed could have been prevented. If the Pentagon had been forced to open the project to competitive bidding, it would have had to consider other proposals in a painstaking review process. If restrictions on UCAs had been in effect, the Pentagon would have had to slow down and finalize the terms of the deal before allowing it to proceed, which might have surfaced its fatal flaws.

sentences.en: If the typical contracting safeguards had been in place, perhaps everything that followed could have been prevented.
sentences.zh: 如果典型的合同保障措施到位，也许接下来发生的一切都可以避免。

sentences.en: If the Pentagon had been forced to open the project to competitive bidding, it would have had to consider other proposals in a painstaking review process.
sentences.zh: 如果五角大楼被迫对该项目进行竞标，它就必须在艰苦的审查过程中考虑其他提案。

sentences.en: If restrictions on UCAs had been in effect, the Pentagon would have had to slow down and finalize the terms of the deal before allowing it to proceed, which might have surfaced its fatal flaws.
sentences.zh: 如果对 UCA 的限制生效，五角大楼将不得不放慢速度并敲定协议条款，然后才允许其继续进行，这可能会暴露其致命缺陷。

blocks.html_en: But one man’s due diligence is another man’s red tape. Soon, Repkon’s flow-forming machines were sailing across the Atlantic, heading eventually for Mesquite.

sentences.en: But one man’s due diligence is another man’s red tape.
sentences.zh: 但一个人的尽职调查却是另一个人的繁文缛节。

sentences.en: Soon, Repkon’s flow-forming machines were sailing across the Atlantic, heading eventually for Mesquite.
sentences.zh: 很快，雷普康的旋压机就横渡大西洋，最终驶向梅斯基特。

blocks.html_en: “This Is Actually Hell”

sentences.en: “This Is Actually Hell”
sentences.zh: “这其实就是地狱”

blocks.html_en: On May 29, 2024, the mood in Mesquite was triumphant. After two short years of planning, the factory was opening, and defense officials and executives gathered there to celebrate.

sentences.en: On May 29, 2024, the mood in Mesquite was triumphant.
sentences.zh: 2024 年 5 月 29 日，梅斯基特的情绪洋溢着胜利的喜悦。

sentences.en: After two short years of planning, the factory was opening, and defense officials and executives gathered there to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 经过短短两年的规划，工厂开业了，国防官员和高管聚集在那里庆祝。

sentences.en: Former Army Secretary Christine Wormuth at the opening of General Dynamics’ artillery factory Sgt.1st Class Nicole Mejia/U.S. Army
sentences.zh: 前陆军部长克里斯蒂娜·沃穆斯 (Christine Wormuth) 在通用动力公司火炮工厂落成典礼上 一级中士 Nicole Mejia/美国军队

blocks.html_en: “Our nation’s defense relies not only on our soldiers and other servicemembers in uniform but on production facilities like this one,” then-Army Secretary Christine Wormuth told seated dignitaries. She stood at a podium branded with the General Dynamics logo, with two howitzers posed behind her. She thanked the company’s CEO, Phebe Novakovic, and Gezen by name. “It’s a pleasure to highlight the fantastic work you all have done,” she said.

sentences.en: “Our nation’s defense relies not only on our soldiers and other servicemembers in uniform but on production facilities like this one,” then-Army Secretary Christine Wormuth told seated dignitaries.
sentences.zh: “我们国家的国防不仅依赖于我们的士兵和其他身着制服的军人，还依赖于像这样的生产设施，”时任陆军部长克里斯蒂娜·沃穆斯对在座的政要说道。

sentences.en: She stood at a podium branded with the General Dynamics logo, with two howitzers posed behind her.
sentences.zh: 她站在带有通用动力公司标志的讲台上，身后摆着两门榴弹炮。

sentences.en: She thanked the company’s CEO, Phebe Novakovic, and Gezen by name.
sentences.zh: 她点名感谢了公司首席执行官 Phebe Novakovic 和 Gezen。

sentences.en: “It’s a pleasure to highlight the fantastic work you all have done,” she said.
sentences.zh: “很高兴能够强调你们所做的出色工作，”她说。

blocks.html_en: But everything was not as fantastic as it appeared. Artillery shells displayed around the plant that day had been shipped in from elsewhere, three former workers told ProPublica. A worker picked one up and was startled to discover it was fake — seemingly made of plastic. General Dynamics had already failed to perform a scheduled first article test, meant to demonstrate the facility could produce shells that met the Army’s specifications. The facility was supposed to start cranking out shells soon, but machines were barely functioning.

sentences.en: But everything was not as fantastic as it appeared.
sentences.zh: 但一切并不像看上去那么美好。

sentences.en: Artillery shells displayed around the plant that day had been shipped in from elsewhere, three former workers told ProPublica.
sentences.zh: 三名前工人告诉 ProPublica，当天工厂周围展示的炮弹是从其他地方运来的。

sentences.en: A worker picked one up and was startled to discover it was fake — seemingly made of plastic.
sentences.zh: 一名工人捡起一个，惊讶地发现它是假的——看起来是塑料做的。

sentences.en: General Dynamics had already failed to perform a scheduled first article test, meant to demonstrate the facility could produce shells that met the Army’s specifications.
sentences.zh: 通用动力公司已经未能执行预定的首件测试，该测试旨在证明该设施可以生产符合陆军规格的炮弹。

sentences.en: The facility was supposed to start cranking out shells soon, but machines were barely functioning.
sentences.zh: 该设施本应很快开始生产炮弹，但机器几乎无法运转。

blocks.html_en: Soon problems seemed to explode out of every corner, according to interviews with 12 former factory workers. For one thing, the flaming robot arms also kept smashing into things. They slammed into computer numerical control machines, breaking their windows and bending their doors. They knocked over shells. They bashed into safety fences. Workers talked about the arms going “rogue” and began calling one of them “Johnny 5” after a sentient military robot from a 1980s movie.

sentences.en: Soon problems seemed to explode out of every corner, according to interviews with 12 former factory workers.
sentences.zh: 根据对 12 名前工厂工人的采访，很快问题似乎就从各个角落爆发出来。

sentences.en: For one thing, the flaming robot arms also kept smashing into things.
sentences.zh: 一方面，燃烧的机械臂还不断撞击物体。

sentences.en: They slammed into computer numerical control machines, breaking their windows and bending their doors.
sentences.zh: 他们猛烈地撞上电脑数控机器，打破了窗户，折弯了门。

sentences.en: They knocked over shells.
sentences.zh: 他们打翻了贝壳。

sentences.en: They bashed into safety fences.
sentences.zh: 他们撞上了安全围栏。

sentences.en: Workers talked about the arms going “rogue” and began calling one of them “Johnny 5” after a sentient military robot from a 1980s movie.
sentences.zh: 工人们谈论这些手臂变得“失控”，并开始将其中一个手臂称为“Johnny 5”，以 20 世纪 80 年代电影中一个有感知能力的军事机器人的名字命名。

blocks.html_en: Even simple equipment failed with slapstick regularity, six workers said. Conveyor belts broke down. Automated carts got lost. Safety gates meant to shut down machines when workers approached did not shut down machines when workers approached. A pipe exploded, spraying water up to the ceiling. Parts on Repkon machines deformed, leading a worker to discover that they were made with Chinese steel, possibly in violation of federal regulations. (The Army said it has no evidence of such violations.)

sentences.en: Even simple equipment failed with slapstick regularity, six workers said.
sentences.zh: 六名工人表示，即使是简单的设备也会经常出现故障。

sentences.en: Conveyor belts broke down.
sentences.zh: 传送带坏了。

sentences.en: Automated carts got lost.
sentences.zh: 自动推车丢失了。

sentences.en: Safety gates meant to shut down machines when workers approached did not shut down machines when workers approached.
sentences.zh: 安全门本应在工人接近时关闭机器，但并没有在工人接近时关闭机器。

sentences.en: A pipe exploded, spraying water up to the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 一根水管爆炸了，水喷到了天花板。

sentences.en: Parts on Repkon machines deformed, leading a worker to discover that they were made with Chinese steel, possibly in violation of federal regulations.
sentences.zh: Repkon 机器上的零件变形，导致工人发现它们是用中国钢材制造的，可能违反了联邦法规。

sentences.en: (The Army said it has no evidence of such violations.)
sentences.zh: （陆军表示没有证据表明此类违规行为。）

sentences.en: Artillery shells at various stages of production were displayed at the factory in Mesquite when it opened.
sentences.zh: 梅斯基特的工厂开业时展示了不同生产阶段的炮弹。

sentences.en: Desiree Rios
sentences.zh: 德西丽·里奥斯

blocks.html_en: Smoke hung in the air; it rolled off the press machines when robots sprayed them with lubricant. Workers could feel the smoke in their lungs. When they blew their noses after shifts, their mucus was black. A worker complained to the Occupational Safety and Health Administration about a “respirable hazard” at the factory, according to an OSHA record and spokesperson. The agency opened an investigation in October 2024, and an inspector visited the facility. The smoke-spewing press machines were scheduled to be operating on the day of the visit, but for some reason they weren’t running during the inspection, according to four former workers. OSHA issued no penalties, the agency told ProPublica. Staffers started to think it wasn’t just Repkon’s faulty equipment to blame for problems at the factory — it was General Dynamics’ management, too.

sentences.en: Smoke hung in the air; it rolled off the press machines when robots sprayed them with lubricant.
sentences.zh: 空气中弥漫着烟雾；当机器人向冲压机喷洒润滑剂时，它就从冲压机上滚了下来。

sentences.en: Workers could feel the smoke in their lungs.
sentences.zh: 工人们可以感觉到肺部冒着烟。

sentences.en: When they blew their noses after shifts, their mucus was black.
sentences.zh: 当他们轮班后擤鼻子时，他们的粘液是黑色的。

sentences.en: A worker complained to the Occupational Safety and Health Administration about a “respirable hazard” at the factory, according to an OSHA record and spokesperson.
sentences.zh: 根据职业安全与健康管理局的记录和发言人，一名工人向职业安全与健康管理局投诉工厂存在“呼吸性危害”。

sentences.en: The agency opened an investigation in October 2024, and an inspector visited the facility.
sentences.zh: 该机构于 2024 年 10 月展开调查，一名检查员参观了该设施。

sentences.en: The smoke-spewing press machines were scheduled to be operating on the day of the visit, but for some reason they weren’t running during the inspection, according to four former workers.
sentences.zh: 据四名前工人称，冒烟的压力机原定在视察当天运行，但由于某种原因，它们在检查期间没有运行。

sentences.en: OSHA issued no penalties, the agency told ProPublica.
sentences.zh: OSHA 告诉 ProPublica，该机构没有发布任何处罚措施。

sentences.en: Staffers started to think it wasn’t just Repkon’s faulty equipment to blame for problems at the factory — it was General Dynamics’ management, too.
sentences.zh: 员工们开始认为，工厂出现问题不仅要归咎于雷普康的设备故障，还应归咎于通用动力公司的管理层。

blocks.html_en: The plant could reach Sahara Desert temperatures when the furnaces or presses were on. “This is actually hell,” one worker thought to himself. It was hotter still inside cabinets containing drives that controlled critical machines, where it was regularly 140 degrees, two former workers told ProPublica. An outside inspector warned in an email reviewed by ProPublica that, at that temperature, “you would not only have drives failing but also human lives failing.”

sentences.en: The plant could reach Sahara Desert temperatures when the furnaces or presses were on.
sentences.zh: 当熔炉或压机启动时，工厂的温度可能会达到撒哈拉沙漠的温度。

sentences.en: “This is actually hell,” one worker thought to himself.
sentences.zh: “这简直就是地狱。”一名工人心里想。

sentences.en: It was hotter still inside cabinets containing drives that controlled critical machines, where it was regularly 140 degrees, two former workers told ProPublica.
sentences.zh: 两名前工人告诉 ProPublica，装有控制关键机器的驱动器的机柜内温度更高，通常为 140 度。

sentences.en: An outside inspector warned in an email reviewed by ProPublica that, at that temperature, “you would not only have drives failing but also human lives failing.”
sentences.zh: 一名外部检查员在 ProPublica 看到的一封电子邮件中警告称，在这种温度下，“不仅会导致驱动器故障，还会导致人员生命危险。”

blocks.html_en: Every day seemed to bring more of the same: another machine broken, another frantic effort to repair it, another batch of misshapen shells tossed into the discard pile. As 2024 became 2025, little seemed to get better.

sentences.en: Every day seemed to bring more of the same: another machine broken, another frantic effort to repair it, another batch of misshapen shells tossed into the discard pile.
sentences.zh: 每天似乎都会带来更多同样的事情：另一台机器坏了，又疯狂地修理它，又一批畸形的炮弹被扔进废弃堆。

sentences.en: As 2024 became 2025, little seemed to get better.
sentences.zh: 随着 2024 年进入 2025 年，情况似乎并没有好转。

blocks.html_en: With so few shells passing inspection stations along the production line, many workers had nothing to do. A cat-and-mouse game ensued. Bored staffers spent endless hours gazing at their phones, leading supervisors to restrict phone use. So workers began bringing crossword books. Managers nixed those. Some workers were seen sleeping, so supervisors took away chairs.

sentences.en: With so few shells passing inspection stations along the production line, many workers had nothing to do.
sentences.zh: 由于生产线上通过检查站的炮弹很少，许多工人无事可做。

sentences.en: A cat-and-mouse game ensued.
sentences.zh: 一场猫捉老鼠的游戏就此展开。

sentences.en: Bored staffers spent endless hours gazing at their phones, leading supervisors to restrict phone use.
sentences.zh: 无聊的员工没完没了地盯着手机，导致主管限制手机的使用。

sentences.en: So workers began bringing crossword books.
sentences.zh: 于是工人们开始带来填字游戏书籍。

sentences.en: Managers nixed those.
sentences.zh: 经理们拒绝了这些。

sentences.en: Some workers were seen sleeping, so supervisors took away chairs.
sentences.zh: 有人看到一些工人在睡觉，所以主管把椅子拿走了。

blocks.html_en: “We sat around twiddling our thumbs, trying to find work, trying to figure out what was going on,” said Natashia Passmore, a former production technician in the plant. “It was a waste of government money, and it was a waste of our time.”

sentences.en: “We sat around twiddling our thumbs, trying to find work, trying to figure out what was going on,” said Natashia Passmore, a former production technician in the plant.
sentences.zh: “我们坐在那里无所事事，试图找到工作，试图弄清楚发生了什么事，”工厂前生产技术员纳塔西娅·帕斯莫尔(Natashia Passmore)说。

sentences.en: “It was a waste of government money, and it was a waste of our time.”
sentences.zh: “这是浪费政府资金，也是浪费我们的时间。”

blocks.html_en: The Dumpster Fire

sentences.en: The Dumpster Fire
sentences.zh: 垃圾箱火灾

blocks.html_en: Tension rose between the Americans hired by General Dynamics and Turkish workers sent over by Repkon. The Repkon team was there to install the equipment, but it seemed equally flummoxed by the problems. General Dynamics workers found them evasive. They would give curt responses to questions in English but then be seen holding long, animated conversations in Turkish outside during frequent smoking breaks. A carelessly discarded cigarette butt sparked a real-life dumpster fire, three former workers said.

sentences.en: Tension rose between the Americans hired by General Dynamics and Turkish workers sent over by Repkon.
sentences.zh: 通用动力公司雇用的美国人与雷普康派来的土耳其工人之间的紧张关系加剧。

sentences.en: The Repkon team was there to install the equipment, but it seemed equally flummoxed by the problems.
sentences.zh: Repkon 团队在那里安装设备，但似乎同样对这些问题感到困惑。

sentences.en: General Dynamics workers found them evasive.
sentences.zh: 通用动力公司的员工发现他们闪烁其词。

sentences.en: They would give curt responses to questions in English but then be seen holding long, animated conversations in Turkish outside during frequent smoking breaks.
sentences.zh: 他们会用英语简短地回答问题，但随后人们会看到他们在户外频繁吸烟的休息时间用土耳其语进行长时间、热烈的对话。

sentences.en: A carelessly discarded cigarette butt sparked a real-life dumpster fire, three former workers said.
sentences.zh: 三名前工人说，一个不小心丢弃的烟头引发了现实生活中的垃圾箱火灾。

blocks.html_en: Repkon was especially secretive about the flow-forming machines, refusing to answer most questions about their operations. General Dynamics workers could tell when Repkon was testing one of them, because they would find metal shards scattered on the floor around it later. The shards looked like alligator teeth. “Oh, the tooth fairy was here,” one worker would think to himself.

sentences.en: Repkon was especially secretive about the flow-forming machines, refusing to answer most questions about their operations.
sentences.zh: 雷普康对旋压机尤其守口如瓶，拒绝回答有关其操作的大多数问题。

sentences.en: General Dynamics workers could tell when Repkon was testing one of them, because they would find metal shards scattered on the floor around it later.
sentences.zh: 通用动力公司的工作人员可以看出雷普康何时测试其中一台，因为稍后他们会发现金属碎片散落在它周围的地板上。

sentences.en: The shards looked like alligator teeth.
sentences.zh: 这些碎片看起来像鳄鱼的牙齿。

sentences.en: “Oh, the tooth fairy was here,” one worker would think to himself.
sentences.zh: “哦，牙仙子来了，”一名工人心里想。

blocks.html_en: Paranoia set in. Repkon refused to share passwords needed to control important equipment, according to five former General Dynamics employees. Sometimes workers would be startled by the sight of a machine moving by itself and realize it was being controlled by someone in Turkey. Spooked, General Dynamics workers tore out hardware to cut off remote access to the machines, two former workers said.

sentences.en: Paranoia set in.
sentences.zh: 偏执狂发作了。

sentences.en: Repkon refused to share passwords needed to control important equipment, according to five former General Dynamics employees.
sentences.zh: 据通用动力公司五名前员工称，雷普康拒绝分享控制重要设备所需的密码。

sentences.en: Sometimes workers would be startled by the sight of a machine moving by itself and realize it was being controlled by someone in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 有时，工人们会被机器自行移动的景象吓到，并意识到它是由土耳其的某人控制的。

sentences.en: Spooked, General Dynamics workers tore out hardware to cut off remote access to the machines, two former workers said.
sentences.zh: 两名前员工表示，通用动力公司的员工受到惊吓，撕毁了硬件，以切断对机器的远程访问。

blocks.html_en: Rumors swirled among the Americans that the Turks were purposefully sabotaging machinery — or perhaps even engaged in some convoluted form of espionage. “It was astonishing how little progress we would make, month after month, year after year,” one former General Dynamics worker said. “People started speculating, ‘I wonder if they’re spying on us.’” General Dynamics assigned someone to shadow the Repkon workers in the factory, two former staffers said. (The Army said it has no evidence of sabotage or spying.)

sentences.en: Rumors swirled among the Americans that the Turks were purposefully sabotaging machinery — or perhaps even engaged in some convoluted form of espionage.
sentences.zh: 美国人中盛传土耳其人故意破坏机器，甚至可能从事某种复杂的间谍活动。

sentences.en: “It was astonishing how little progress we would make, month after month, year after year,” one former General Dynamics worker said.
sentences.zh: “令人惊讶的是，我们月复一月、年复一年所取得的进展是如此之小，”一位前通用动力公司员工说道。

sentences.en: “People started speculating, ‘I wonder if they’re spying on us.’” General Dynamics assigned someone to shadow the Repkon workers in the factory, two former staffers said.
sentences.zh: “人们开始猜测，‘我想知道他们是否在监视我们。’”两名前员工表示，通用动力公司派人跟踪工厂里的雷普康工人。

sentences.en: (The Army said it has no evidence of sabotage or spying.)
sentences.zh: （陆军表示没有任何破坏或间谍活动的证据。）

blocks.html_en: Even the buildings themselves — a trio of vast, anonymous boxes tucked into the crook of two freeways — were plagued with problems. Walls cracked, and daylight became visible around window frames. Doors began dragging on concrete floors. When it rained, water would flood in — “like a tsunami,” one former worker said. The foundations appeared to be shifting or sinking, six former employees said. It was as if the whole dysfunctional factory — its fires and smoke, its idle workers and haywire machines — was being slowly sucked down into the earth.

sentences.en: Even the buildings themselves — a trio of vast, anonymous boxes tucked into the crook of two freeways — were plagued with problems.
sentences.zh: 甚至建筑物本身——三个巨大的、无名的盒子塞在两条高速公路的拐弯处——也受到了问题的困扰。

sentences.en: Walls cracked, and daylight became visible around window frames.
sentences.zh: 墙壁开裂，窗框周围可见日光。

sentences.en: Doors began dragging on concrete floors.
sentences.zh: 门开始在水泥地板上拖动。

sentences.en: When it rained, water would flood in — “like a tsunami,” one former worker said.
sentences.zh: 下雨时，水就会涌入——“就像海啸一样”，一位前工人说。

sentences.en: The foundations appeared to be shifting or sinking, six former employees said.
sentences.zh: 六名前员工表示，地基似乎正在移动或下沉。

sentences.en: It was as if the whole dysfunctional factory — its fires and smoke, its idle workers and haywire machines — was being slowly sucked down into the earth.
sentences.zh: 就好像整个功能失调的工厂——它的火灾和烟雾、闲置的工人和失控的机器——正在慢慢地被吸进地下。

blocks.html_en: Faced with the kaleidoscopic array of problems, the response from General Dynamics managers always seemed to be to plow forward. “Every single time they opened their mouths, it was: ‘We need to get into production,’” one former worker said. “Production is the only thing that mattered.”

sentences.en: Faced with the kaleidoscopic array of problems, the response from General Dynamics managers always seemed to be to plow forward.
sentences.zh: 面对千变万化的问题，通用动力公司管理者的反应似乎总是奋力向前。

sentences.en: “Every single time they opened their mouths, it was: ‘We need to get into production,’” one former worker said.
sentences.zh: “他们每次开口都是：‘我们需要投入生产，’”一位前工人说。

sentences.en: “Production is the only thing that mattered.”
sentences.zh: “生产是唯一重要的事情。”

blocks.html_en: “Nobody Wins”

sentences.en: “Nobody Wins”
sentences.zh: “没有人赢”

blocks.html_en: As the situation at the factory deteriorated, General Dynamics and the Army told a very different story to the public.

sentences.en: As the situation at the factory deteriorated, General Dynamics and the Army told a very different story to the public.
sentences.zh: 随着工厂情况的恶化，通用动力公司和陆军向公众讲述了一个截然不同的故事。

blocks.html_en: In April 2024, General Dynamics CEO Novakovic told investors: “In the U.S., we are rapidly increasing ammunition production with the opening of our Texas facility.” General Dynamics failed to conduct a scheduled first article test in Mesquite that same month.

sentences.en: In April 2024, General Dynamics CEO Novakovic told investors: “In the U.S., we are rapidly increasing ammunition production with the opening of our Texas facility.”
sentences.zh: 2024 年 4 月，通用动力首席执行官诺瓦科维奇告诉投资者：“在美国，随着德克萨斯州工厂的开业，我们正在迅速增加弹药产量。”

sentences.en: General Dynamics failed to conduct a scheduled first article test in Mesquite that same month.
sentences.zh: 同月，通用动力公司未能在梅斯基特进行预定的首件测试。

blocks.html_en: That July, two months after the opening ceremony, Novakovic told investors that “the first line is running and producing as we anticipated.” In fact, the first line was not producing any usable shells, six former plant workers told ProPublica.

sentences.en: That July, two months after the opening ceremony, Novakovic told investors that “the first line is running and producing as we anticipated.”
sentences.zh: 那年 7 月，即开业仪式两个月后，诺瓦科维奇告诉投资者，“第一条生产线正在按照我们的预期运行和生产。”

sentences.en: In fact, the first line was not producing any usable shells, six former plant workers told ProPublica.
sentences.zh: 事实上，六名前工厂工人告诉 ProPublica，第一条生产线并未生产任何可用的炮弹。

blocks.html_en: In September Doug Bush, then the Army’s acquisition czar and a key figure overseeing the project, said “there have been no major delays” to the Army’s goal of producing 100,000 artillery shells each month — a goal for which the Mesquite factory was critical. “Any delays you’ve had have been measured in, I would call them weeks, not months, certainly not years,” Bush told reporters. He downplayed the problems, describing them as merely a matter of adjusting a machine “so that it puts out shells just so, versus a little bit off.”

sentences.en: In September Doug Bush, then the Army’s acquisition czar and a key figure overseeing the project, said “there have been no major delays” to the Army’s goal of producing 100,000 artillery shells each month — a goal for which the Mesquite factory was critical.
sentences.zh: 9月，时任陆军采购沙皇、监督该项目的关键人物道格·布什表示​​，陆军每月生产 10 万枚炮弹的目标“没有出现重大延误”——而梅斯基特工厂对于这一目标至关重要。

sentences.en: “Any delays you’ve had have been measured in, I would call them weeks, not months, certainly not years,” Bush told reporters.
sentences.zh: 布什对记者说：“任何延误都经过衡量，我会把它们称为几周，而不是几个月，当然不是几年。”

sentences.en: He downplayed the problems, describing them as merely a matter of adjusting a machine “so that it puts out shells just so, versus a little bit off.”
sentences.zh: 他淡化了这些问题，将其描述为仅仅是调整机器的问题，“使其能够准确地射出炮弹，而不是稍微偏离一点”。

blocks.html_en: The next day, a laborer in Mesquite photographed the work of a machine meant to begin giving the shells perfectly smooth noses; it had instead mangled the metal into something that resembled the swirl of soft-serve ice cream.

sentences.en: The next day, a laborer in Mesquite photographed the work of a machine meant to begin giving the shells perfectly smooth noses; it had instead mangled the metal into something that resembled the swirl of soft-serve ice cream.
sentences.zh: 第二天，梅斯基特的一名工人拍摄了一台机器的工作情况，该机器旨在开始为贝壳提供完美光滑的鼻子；相反，它把金属破碎成类似软冰淇淋漩涡的东西。

sentences.en: A machine at the factory sometimes mangled artillery shells, meant to be perfectly smooth, into swirls that looked like soft serve.
sentences.zh: 工厂里的一台机器有时会将本来应该非常光滑的炮弹打碎成看起来像软发球的漩涡。

sentences.en: Obtained by ProPublica
sentences.zh: 由ProPublica获得

blocks.html_en: Also in September, Secretary Wormuth touted the Army’s artillery ramp-up at a conference, saying, “part of what’s enabling that are things like the brand-new plant that we opened up in Mesquite.” One month later, an Army contracting officer sent General Dynamics a letter of concern about its performance at the facility. The company missed the Army’s deadline for completing the first production line one month after that. (Wormuth declined to comment.)

sentences.en: Also in September, Secretary Wormuth touted the Army’s artillery ramp-up at a conference, saying, “part of what’s enabling that are things like the brand-new plant that we opened up in Mesquite.”
sentences.zh: 同样在 9 月，沃穆斯部长在一次会议上吹捧了陆军炮兵的发展，他说：“实现这一目标的部分原因是我们在梅斯基特开设的全新工厂。”

sentences.en: One month later, an Army contracting officer sent General Dynamics a letter of concern about its performance at the facility.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，一名陆军合同官员向通用动力公司发送了一封对其在该设施表现的担忧信。

sentences.en: The company missed the Army’s deadline for completing the first production line one month after that.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，该公司错过了陆军完成第一条生产线的最后期限。

sentences.en: (Wormuth declined to comment.)
sentences.zh: （沃穆斯拒绝发表评论。）

blocks.html_en: Despite it all, Gezen remained optimistic through the fall of 2024. The issues in Mesquite were mere delays, he thought, and there were plans in place to fix them, according to a person familiar with his thinking. “If Firat’s guilty of something, it’s not wanting to see the truth in the matter,” a former colleague said. He “has a tendency to not want to listen to bad news.” General Dynamics announced Gezen’s retirement in January 2025. Some industry insiders believe he was pushed out in part over Mesquite. (Gezen denied that but declined to sit for an on-the-record interview.)

sentences.en: Despite it all, Gezen remained optimistic through the fall of 2024.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，Gezen 在 2024 年秋季仍然保持乐观。

sentences.en: The issues in Mesquite were mere delays, he thought, and there were plans in place to fix them, according to a person familiar with his thinking.
sentences.zh: 据一位熟悉他想法的人士透露，他认为梅斯基特的问题只是延误，并且已经制定了解决这些问题的计划。

sentences.en: “If Firat’s guilty of something, it’s not wanting to see the truth in the matter,” a former colleague said.
sentences.zh: “如果 Firat 犯了某件事，它就不想看到事情的真相，”一位前同事说。

sentences.en: He “has a tendency to not want to listen to bad news.”
sentences.zh: 他“有不想听坏消息的倾向”。

sentences.en: General Dynamics announced Gezen’s retirement in January 2025.
sentences.zh: 通用动力公司宣布 Gezen 于 2025 年 1 月退役。

sentences.en: Some industry insiders believe he was pushed out in part over Mesquite.
sentences.zh: 一些业内人士认为，他被驱逐的部分原因是梅斯基特。

sentences.en: (Gezen denied that but declined to sit for an on-the-record interview.)
sentences.zh: （格森否认了这一点，但拒绝接受正式采访。）

blocks.html_en: The split screen of blown deadlines and rosy public comments continued into the second administration of President Donald Trump. In April 2025, General Dynamics missed the completion date for the second production line. That same month, Novakovic told investors, once again: “We are rapidly increasing munitions capacity and production with the opening of our projectile facility in Texas.” The company missed another first article test two months later.

sentences.en: The split screen of blown deadlines and rosy public comments continued into the second administration of President Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 截止日期提前和公众评论乐观的局面一直持续到唐纳德·特朗普总统的第二届政府。

sentences.en: In April 2025, General Dynamics missed the completion date for the second production line.
sentences.zh: 2025年4月，通用动力公司错过了第二条生产线的竣工日期。

sentences.en: That same month, Novakovic told investors, once again: “We are rapidly increasing munitions capacity and production with the opening of our projectile facility in Texas.”
sentences.zh: 同月，诺瓦科维奇再次告诉投资者：“随着德克萨斯州弹丸工厂的开业，我们正在迅速提高弹药产能和产量。”

sentences.en: The company missed another first article test two months later.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，该公司再次错过了首篇文章测试。

blocks.html_en: As the failures mounted, a sinking feeling took hold in Army offices. The service assembled a team to assess the situation in the factory, which produced a report that gave little confidence the problems could be fixed. Finally, in June 2025, the Army told General Dynamics it was considering terminating the contract awards for the plant, a defense trade publication reported at the time. Two months later, the service ordered work halted on two of the factory’s three production lines.

sentences.en: As the failures mounted, a sinking feeling took hold in Army offices.
sentences.zh: 随着失败的增加，陆军办公室里弥漫着一种沮丧的感觉。

sentences.en: The service assembled a team to assess the situation in the factory, which produced a report that gave little confidence the problems could be fixed.
sentences.zh: 该部门组建了一个团队来评估工厂的情况，该团队编写的报告对问题的解决缺乏信心。

sentences.en: Finally, in June 2025, the Army told General Dynamics it was considering terminating the contract awards for the plant, a defense trade publication reported at the time.
sentences.zh: 最终，据当时的一份国防贸易出版物报道，2025 年 6 月，陆军告诉通用动力公司，它正在考虑终止该工厂的合同授予。

sentences.en: Two months later, the service ordered work halted on two of the factory’s three production lines.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，该部门下令工厂三条生产线中的两条停工。

blocks.html_en: But the Army did not unilaterally terminate the contract awards. “A termination for default would’ve taken years through the legal system, because General Dynamics wasn’t going to accept that,” a former Army official told ProPublica. “Nobody wins except the lawyers.”

sentences.en: But the Army did not unilaterally terminate the contract awards.
sentences.zh: 但陆军并没有单方面终止授予合同。

sentences.en: “A termination for default would’ve taken years through the legal system, because General Dynamics wasn’t going to accept that,” a former Army official told ProPublica.
sentences.zh: 一位前陆军官员告诉 ProPublica：“通过法律体系来终止违约可能需要数年时间，因为通用动力公司不会接受这一点。”

sentences.en: “Nobody wins except the lawyers.”
sentences.zh: “除了律师，没有人会赢。”

blocks.html_en: This would not be the last act of generosity from the Trump administration to General Dynamics. In December 2025, according to the inspector general’s report, the government paid the company $26.3 million in “progress payments” for the second and third production lines in Mesquite, although neither line had ever produced a usable shell.

sentences.en: This would not be the last act of generosity from the Trump administration to General Dynamics.
sentences.zh: 这不会是特朗普政府对通用动力公司的最后一次慷慨之举。

sentences.en: In December 2025, according to the inspector general’s report, the government paid the company $26.3 million in “progress payments” for the second and third production lines in Mesquite, although neither line had ever produced a usable shell.
sentences.zh: 根据监察长的报告，2025 年 12 月，政府向该公司支付了 2630 万美元的“进度款”，用于梅斯基特的第二条和第三条生产线，尽管两条生产线都从未生产过可用的外壳。

sentences.en: General Dynamics’ factory in Mesquite, photographed in August Desiree Rios for ProPublica
sentences.zh: 通用动力位于梅斯基特的工厂，摄于 8 月 Desiree Rios 为 ProPublica 拍摄

blocks.html_en: A Novel Solution

sentences.en: A Novel Solution
sentences.zh: 新颖的解决方案

blocks.html_en: Two months ago, General Dynamics made an announcement that conjured a sense of déjà vu. To fix the problems at the factory, the company would team up with yet another unheard-of partner promising technological innovation. The solution this time? Artificial intelligence.

sentences.en: Two months ago, General Dynamics made an announcement that conjured a sense of déjà vu.
sentences.zh: 两个月前，通用动力公司发布的公告让人有一种似曾相识的感觉。

sentences.en: To fix the problems at the factory, the company would team up with yet another unheard-of partner promising technological innovation.
sentences.zh: 为了解决工厂的问题，该公司将与另一个闻所未闻的合作伙伴合作，承诺进行技术创新。

sentences.en: The solution this time?
sentences.zh: 这次的解决方案是？

sentences.en: Artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 人工智能。

blocks.html_en: A news release from General Dynamics and the new company, Deterrence, was filled with techno-business jargon. “AI-enabled capabilities” and “intelligence and connectivity” would be added at Mesquite and other General Dynamics factories, the companies wrote. “AI transforms production facilities into strategic assets,” Deterrence’s CEO said in the release. “We’re building autonomous manufacturing systems that learn, adapt, and scale in real time.”

sentences.en: A news release from General Dynamics and the new company, Deterrence, was filled with techno-business jargon.
sentences.zh: 通用动力公司和新公司 Deterrence 发布的新闻稿充满了技术商业术语。

sentences.en: “AI-enabled capabilities” and “intelligence and connectivity” would be added at Mesquite and other General Dynamics factories, the companies wrote.
sentences.zh: 两家公司写道，梅斯基特和其他通用动力工厂将增加“人工智能功能”和“智能和连接”。

sentences.en: “AI transforms production facilities into strategic assets,” Deterrence’s CEO said in the release.
sentences.zh: “人工智能将生产设施转变为战略资产，”Deterrence 首席执行官在新闻稿中表示。

sentences.en: “We’re building autonomous manufacturing systems that learn, adapt, and scale in real time.”
sentences.zh: “我们正在构建能够实时学习、适应和扩展的自主制造系统。”

blocks.html_en: These pronouncements have baffled former Mesquite workers. “What are they talking about? There’s nothing to learn or adapt or scale,” one said. “It’s all broken.”

sentences.en: These pronouncements have baffled former Mesquite workers.
sentences.zh: 这些声明让前梅斯基特工人感到困惑。

sentences.en: “What are they talking about?
sentences.zh: “他们在说什么？

sentences.en: There’s nothing to learn or adapt or scale,” one said.
sentences.zh: 没有什么可以学习、适应或扩展的，”一位人士说道。

sentences.en: “It’s all broken.”
sentences.zh: “都坏了。”

blocks.html_en: General Dynamics is doing this even as it replaces most of the Repkon equipment with traditional machines like those used in Scranton. How AI will wrest miracles from decades-old technology is unclear. content_html_zh:
报告要点

  • 准备、开火、瞄准：在不受正常规则约束的仓促过程中，陆军聘请了通用动力公司来制造炮弹，通用动力公司在几乎没有经过审查的情况下聘请了一家土耳其分包商。
  • 白花钱：尽管获得了 5.33 亿美元的报酬，通用动力公司并没有在其新工厂生产出任何可用的炮弹，也没有被公开追究责任。
  • 失败的代价：自从陆军停顿了工厂的两条生产线以来，负责这场灾难的通用动力部门已经获得了总计 25 亿美元的合同。

这些精彩片段是由参与这篇报道的记者和编辑撰写的。

一个机器人着火了。 再次。

那是 2024 年的夏天，通用动力公司位于达拉斯附近闷热的火炮工厂内的尖端机器人经常着火，据该工厂的四名前工人称。 这并不理想，因为该工厂应该为乌克兰生产急需的炮弹。 这些机器人是巨大的金属手臂，手上有夹子，最终会被油浸透，毫不奇怪，当它们将加热到 1800 度的钢块移入和移出机器时，机器会定期喷出火柱，这并不奇怪。 那年夏天的一场大火熔化了机器人的电缆，使其无法使用一周。

就在几周前，国防官员和高管还在盛大的开幕仪式上宣传了该工厂从土耳其进口的创新型新机械。 但员工们已经习惯了巨大的事故，无论是激烈的还是其他的。 “第二次、第三次、第四次之后，这几乎变得正常了，”一位前工人说。 “到了我对那里发生的任何事情都不感到惊讶的地步。”

这些昂贵的机器并没有以高效、精简的方式生产贝壳，而是不断以奇怪的方式出现故障。 机器人手臂会失去控制地摆动，撞上精心校准的设备，有时它们会意外地将大块钢铁掉落到 5 英尺高的地板上。 该工厂的标志性装置旨在精确拉伸炮弹的钢材，但往往会导致其破裂而无法修复。 然后是巨大的压力机，需要用大锤定期敲击才能正常工作，但仍然会破坏几乎每个贝壳的成型。 “我们确实没有任何标准化的做法，”前员工昆特尔·怀特 (Quantel White) 说。 “只是一群人每天晚上轮流拿着大锤敲击机器。” 对于工人们来说，就连厂房本身也感觉注定要失败，在 100 华氏度的高温下，刺鼻的烟雾悬在地基上，似乎要沉入地下。

情况始终没有改善。 为该工厂提供资金的美国陆军于 2025 年 8 月下令停止其三条生产线中的两条生产线。 到那时，通用动力公司已经提前了八个最后期限。 根据国防部监察长 7 月份的一份报告，第三条生产线的工作仍在继续，但该设施从未生产出任何可用的炮弹。

据陆军称，这次惨败已使美国纳税人损失了 5.33 亿美元。 但陆军并没有要求通用动力公司或一家重要的土耳其分包商（该分包商为该工厂提供了大肆宣传但几乎没有经过验证的设备）对这些故障公开负责。 通用动力公司也没有偿还一分钱。

恰恰相反：全球最大的国防公司之一通用动力公司获得了大量新合同，继续保持其作为五角大楼支出最大受益者之一的记录。 该工厂仍由该公司负责。 它最近宣布将通过引入另一种大肆宣传但未经证实的技术来解决这个问题。

“这绝对是一场灾难，”一名负责监督该项目的陆军办公室前官员表示。 这位不愿透露姓名的官员补充说：“陆军应该从通用动力公司收回资金。”他和其他接受采访的人一样，都要求匿名。

在公开场合，陆军一直对这家位于梅斯基特郊区的工厂到底出了什么问题守口如瓶。 监察长报告描述了这次失败，但提供了一些细节。 它没有透露所涉公司的名称，更不用说任何负责的个人了。 该报告的建议不温不火：陆军应该确定合同是否“适当签发”、“钱是如何花的”以及是否能够收回其中的任何部分。 它还应该“确定并实施解决方案”来生产更多火炮。 陆军官员推卸责任，告诉监察长他们没有做错任何事。

在给 ProPublica 的一份详细声明中，陆军表示将通过从通用动力公司获得生产订单的未具体说明的折扣来收回该项目的资金。 声明中写道：“陆军正在实行严格的监督，以确保投入的每一美元都能为作战人员提供能力。” “当供应商未能满足合同规格时，如梅斯基特工厂所见，我们正在评估合同履行情况，寻求资金收回，并调整资源。”

至于通用动力公司，则没有给出任何公开解释。 根据监察长报告，该公司表示“达到或超过了要求”。 通用动力公司拒绝了 ProPublica 的采访请求。 公司发言人杰夫·戴维斯 (Jeff Davis) 表示，ProPublica 的报道“从根本上歪曲了情况，并错误地质疑了我们员工安全和对客户诚实的记录。” 他继续说道：“基于此基础的文章将是一篇实质上虚假且具有误导性的热门文章。” 戴维斯没有回应 ProPublica 要求他指出所指控的错误的要求。

ProPublica 通过采访通用动力公司、陆军、五角大楼和白宫的 36 名现任和前任员工，重现了该项目是如何出错的。 ProPublica 还审查了公司内部文件以及工厂内拍摄的照片和视频。

相关人士描述了这个项目从一开始就仓促且考虑不周。 国会铺平了道路，取消了政府合同护栏——旨在确保纳税人的钱不被浪费——以便与乌克兰相关的国防项目能够迅速获得资金。 陆军利用这一机会，在不知道通用动力公司计划使用的机器是否能够完成所需工作的情况下，向通用动力公司提供了利润丰厚的无投标合同。 四名前陆军和通用动力公司官员告诉 ProPublica，陆军的尽职调查不够充分。

与其他国防部项目的数十亿美元预算相比，德克萨斯州灾难的财务成本很小。 但在国防开支批评者看来，相关公司缺乏后果是一个更大问题的征兆：五角大楼和国会有一种根深蒂固的文化，在这种文化中，代价高昂的失败只会导致更多的支出。 这些批评人士担心，如果特朗普政府成功地将国防预算从 1 万亿美元增加到 1.5 万亿美元，像这样的极端案例可能会变得更加普遍。 美国政府还为针对伊朗的战争寻求数百亿美元的资金，并向国防公司施压，要求其迅速提高武器生产。

国防预算研究员威廉·哈同表示：“承包商往往不对自己的错误承担责任。” 他说，得克萨斯州的失败“预示着如果特朗普政府获得其要求的预算，将会发生什么。”

球场

2022 年 2 月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰对拜登政府来说就像是一次紧急事件。 对于通用动力公司来说，这是一个机会。 菲拉特·格森 (Firat Gezen) 已做好投球准备。

在经营通用动力公司军械和战术系统业务的六年时间里，格曾赢得了灵巧的战略家和推销员的声誉。 50岁的他不是一名工程师，也没有经营工厂的经验。 他在武器业务的财务方面工作了数十年。 他面带微笑，说话流畅，就像他的秃头一样，他知道如何吸引企业领导人和五角大楼的武器买家。

盖森也很精明。 2020 年，在陆军试图通过与宾夕法尼亚州的一家小公司签订合同来实现火炮供应商基础多元化之后，Gezen 突然介入并收购了该公司。 这使得通用动力公司得以保持对美国标准炮弹金属炮体生产的控制，其口径为：155毫米。 一位前陆军官员说：“菲拉特用手臂搂着你，和你很友善地交谈。” “但他有五样东西是他唯一提供的，而且是独家的。 他把你永远关起来了。”

这使通用动力公司处于一个理想的位置。 俄罗斯和乌克兰每天来回发射数千枚炮弹。 美国是乌克兰的主要供应商，但数十年的撤资导致美国火炮工业日渐衰弱。 2022 年 3 月，国会通过了一系列法案中的第一项，为乌克兰相关事业拨款数十亿美元，其中包括提高火炮生产。 下个月，总统乔·拜登承诺向乌克兰发送炮弹，他希望迅速采取行动。 但首先必须有人制作它们。

一个世纪以来，155 毫米炮弹因其简单而致命的威力而一直是军事主力。 这个 33 英寸的圆筒装满了 TNT，从榴弹炮的炮管中射出时可以行驶 10 英里，撞击后碎片会飞出数百英尺。 但中东数十年的不对称战争（美国主要依靠无人机和炸弹）让一些人相信炮战的时代正在消失。 到 2022 年，通用动力公司成为美国唯一一家 155 毫米金属弹体生产商，主要在宾夕法尼亚州斯克兰顿的一座拥有百年历史的工厂生产。

鉴于此，该公司显然是满足突然出现的新需求的候选者。 通用动力公司可以简单地复制斯克兰顿的传统制造方法，这种方法可以追溯到朝鲜战争时期。 但在 2022 年秋季与五角大楼官员举行的会议上，格曾提出了一个替代方案：如果陆军资助一条使用有前途的新技术的最先进的生产线会怎样？

这一提议的核心是美国国防界一个几乎不知名的人：雷普康。 该公司已在其祖国土耳其运营数十年，提供“金属成型行业的交钥匙生产设施”。 （巧合的是，格曾本人出生在美国，父母是土耳其人。）

但雷普康从未收到过五角大楼的合同，当然也没有收到过其标志性金属加工工艺“旋压成型”的合同。 斯克兰顿方法主要涉及在巨型锻压机中模制超热钢，而雷普康则增加了一个步骤，其中快速旋转机器将金属像陶轮上的粘土一样挤压和滚压出来。 格曾告诉国防官员，其优点是相同的设备可以生产不同口径的炮弹。 最重要的是，雷普康已经拥有一条可用的生产线，这意味着通用动力公司可以比逐件采购传统设备更快地开始制造炮弹。

警告信号比比皆是。 陆军官员了解到，雷普康想要出售的生产线旨在生产一种较旧、较简单的 155 毫米炮弹型号，该炮弹由不同的钢材制成。 据四名前通用动力公司和陆军官员称，目前还不清楚土耳其设备是否可以与用于制造新型 155 毫米型号的钢材配合使用，因为该设备从未实际生产过这种型号。 雷普孔表示，其他国家正在使用这些机器来生产旧型号。 但雷普康以客户隐私为由告诉他们，陆军和通用动力公司无法检查这些活跃的生产线。

陆军本可以对这一切犹豫不决，并坚持更多地了解雷普康机器执行所需工作的能力。 但学习更多内容需要时间，而时间似乎很紧张。 一位前陆军官员表示：“快速行动面临着令人难以置信的压力。” 大家都向前迈进了。

2022 年 11 月，陆军竞相向通用动力公司授予了该项目一系列合同中的第一个合同，如果完成，该项目最终价值近 6 亿美元。 下个月，国会授予国防部非凡权力，可以在没有通常的合同保障措施的情况下为与乌克兰相关的事业提供资金，从而放弃了竞争性招标要求和对所谓的未明确合同行动的限制。 UCA 允许公司在与政府最终确定合同条款之前就开始工作。 一位国防高管将它们比作“在驾驶飞机时建造飞机”。

陆军充分利用其扩大的权力，向通用动力公司授予了一些 UCA，而没有在竞标过程中考虑替代提案。 （陆军告诉 ProPublica，之所以选择该公司是因为其独特的火炮生产经验。）

事实上，陆军对该提案非常着迷，以至于决定订购比格曾提出的数量还要多的订单。 陆军没有签约购买一条雷普康生产线，而是购买了三条。 不知道其中任何一个是否有效。

格曾从未监督过如此雄心勃勃的项目。 在此之前，他主要主持使用传统方法对现有工厂进行较小规模的扩建。 但他乐观地认为这会奏效。 “他非常有进取心，愿意承担风险，”一位前同事说。

陆军对该提案的部分审查是在开始授予合同后才进行的。 四名前通用动力公司和陆军官员表示，军方和通用动力公司派出工作人员前往土耳其检查雷普康的机器，但他们从未检查过整条运行中的生产线，也没有足够的专家能够发现设备中的潜在缺陷。 至关重要的是，在批准这笔交易之前，陆军并没有要求通用动力公司证明它可以使用 Repkon 设备来完成整个生产过程并制造符合陆军规格的炮弹。 （陆军告诉 ProPublica，“在完整的机械安装之前无法进行正式测试。”）

如果典型的合同保障措施到位，也许接下来发生的一切都可以避免。 如果五角大楼被迫对该项目进行竞标，它就必须在艰苦的审查过程中考虑其他提案。 如果对 UCA 的限制生效，五角大楼将不得不放慢速度并敲定协议条款，然后才允许其继续进行，这可能会暴露其致命缺陷。

但一个人的尽职调查却是另一个人的繁文缛节。 很快，雷普康的旋压机就横渡大西洋，最终驶向梅斯基特。

“这其实就是地狱”

2024 年 5 月 29 日，梅斯基特的情绪洋溢着胜利的喜悦。 经过短短两年的规划，工厂开业了，国防官员和高管聚集在那里庆祝。

“我们国家的国防不仅依赖于我们的士兵和其他身着制服的军人，还依赖于像这样的生产设施，”时任陆军部长克里斯蒂娜·沃穆斯对在座的政要说道。 她站在带有通用动力公司标志的讲台上，身后摆着两门榴弹炮。 她点名感谢了公司首席执行官 Phebe Novakovic 和 Gezen。 “很高兴能够强调你们所做的出色工作，”她说。

但一切并不像看上去那么美好。 三名前工人告诉 ProPublica，当天工厂周围展示的炮弹是从其他地方运来的。 一名工人捡起一个，惊讶地发现它是假的——看起来是塑料做的。 通用动力公司已经未能执行预定的首件测试，该测试旨在证明该设施可以生产符合陆军规格的炮弹。 该设施本应很快开始生产炮弹，但机器几乎无法运转。

根据对 12 名前工厂工人的采访，很快问题似乎就从各个角落爆发出来。 一方面，燃烧的机械臂还不断撞击物体。 他们猛烈地撞上电脑数控机器，打破了窗户，折弯了门。 他们打翻了贝壳。 他们撞上了安全围栏。 工人们谈论这些手臂变得“失控”，并开始将其中一个手臂称为“Johnny 5”，以 20 世纪 80 年代电影中一个有感知能力的军事机器人的名字命名。

六名工人表示，即使是简单的设备也会经常出现故障。 传送带坏了。 自动推车丢失了。 安全门本应在工人接近时关闭机器，但并没有在工人接近时关闭机器。 一根水管爆炸了，水喷到了天花板。 Repkon 机器上的零件变形，导致工人发现它们是用中国钢材制造的，可能违反了联邦法规。 （陆军表示没有证据表明此类违规行为。）

空气中弥漫着烟雾；当机器人向冲压机喷洒润滑剂时，它就从冲压机上滚了下来。 工人们可以感觉到肺部冒着烟。 当他们轮班后擤鼻子时，他们的粘液是黑色的。 根据职业安全与健康管理局的记录和发言人，一名工人向职业安全与健康管理局投诉工厂存在“呼吸性危害”。 该机构于 2024 年 10 月展开调查，一名检查员参观了该设施。 据四名前工人称，冒烟的压力机原定在视察当天运行，但由于某种原因，它们在检查期间没有运行。 OSHA 告诉 ProPublica，该机构没有发布任何处罚措施。 员工们开始认为，工厂出现问题不仅要归咎于雷普康的设备故障，还应归咎于通用动力公司的管理层。

当熔炉或压机启动时，工厂的温度可能会达到撒哈拉沙漠的温度。 “这简直就是地狱。”一名工人心里想。 两名前工人告诉 ProPublica，装有控制关键机器的驱动器的机柜内温度更高，通常为 140 度。 一名外部检查员在 ProPublica 看到的一封电子邮件中警告称，在这种温度下，“不仅会导致驱动器故障，还会导致人员生命危险。”

每天似乎都会带来更多同样的事情：另一台机器坏了，又疯狂地修理它，又一批畸形的炮弹被扔进废弃堆。 随着 2024 年进入 2025 年，情况似乎并没有好转。

由于生产线上通过检查站的炮弹很少，许多工人无事可做。 一场猫捉老鼠的游戏就此展开。 无聊的员工没完没了地盯着手机，导致主管限制手机的使用。 于是工人们开始带来填字游戏书籍。 经理们拒绝了这些。 有人看到一些工人在睡觉，所以主管把椅子拿走了。

“我们坐在那里无所事事，试图找到工作，试图弄清楚发生了什么事，”工厂前生产技术员纳塔西娅·帕斯莫尔(Natashia Passmore)说。 “这是浪费政府资金，也是浪费我们的时间。”

垃圾箱火灾

通用动力公司雇用的美国人与雷普康派来的土耳其工人之间的紧张关系加剧。 Repkon 团队在那里安装设备，但似乎同样对这些问题感到困惑。 通用动力公司的员工发现他们闪烁其词。 他们会用英语简短地回答问题，但随后人们会看到他们在户外频繁吸烟的休息时间用土耳其语进行长时间、热烈的对话。 三名前工人说，一个不小心丢弃的烟头引发了现实生活中的垃圾箱火灾。

雷普康对旋压机尤其守口如瓶，拒绝回答有关其操作的大多数问题。 通用动力公司的工作人员可以看出雷普康何时测试其中一台，因为稍后他们会发现金属碎片散落在它周围的地板上。 这些碎片看起来像鳄鱼的牙齿。 “哦，牙仙子来了，”一名工人心里想。

偏执狂发作了。 据通用动力公司五名前员工称，雷普康拒绝分享控制重要设备所需的密码。 有时，工人们会被机器自行移动的景象吓到，并意识到它是由土耳其的某人控制的。 两名前员工表示，通用动力公司的员工受到惊吓，撕毁了硬件，以切断对机器的远程访问。

美国人中盛传土耳其人故意破坏机器，甚至可能从事某种复杂的间谍活动。 “令人惊讶的是，我们月复一月、年复一年所取得的进展是如此之小，”一位前通用动力公司员工说道。 “人们开始猜测，‘我想知道他们是否在监视我们。’”两名前员工表示，通用动力公司派人跟踪工厂里的雷普康工人。 （陆军表示没有任何破坏或间谍活动的证据。）

甚至建筑物本身——三个巨大的、无名的盒子塞在两条高速公路的拐弯处——也受到了问题的困扰。 墙壁开裂，窗框周围可见日光。 门开始在水泥地板上拖动。 下雨时，水就会涌入——“就像海啸一样”，一位前工人说。 六名前员工表示，地基似乎正在移动或下沉。 就好像整个功能失调的工厂——它的火灾和烟雾、闲置的工人和失控的机器——正在慢慢地被吸进地下。

面对千变万化的问题，通用动力公司管理者的反应似乎总是奋力向前。 “他们每次开口都是：‘我们需要投入生产，’”一位前工人说。 “生产是唯一重要的事情。”

“没有人赢”

随着工厂情况的恶化，通用动力公司和陆军向公众讲述了一个截然不同的故事。

2024 年 4 月，通用动力首席执行官诺瓦科维奇告诉投资者：“在美国，随着德克萨斯州工厂的开业，我们正在迅速增加弹药产量。” 同月，通用动力公司未能在梅斯基特进行预定的首件测试。

那年 7 月，即开业仪式两个月后，诺瓦科维奇告诉投资者，“第一条生产线正在按照我们的预期运行和生产。” 事实上，六名前工厂工人告诉 ProPublica，第一条生产线并未生产任何可用的炮弹。

9月，时任陆军采购沙皇、监督该项目的关键人物道格·布什表示​​，陆军每月生产 10 万枚炮弹的目标“没有出现重大延误”——而梅斯基特工厂对于这一目标至关重要。 布什对记者说：“任何延误都经过衡量，我会把它们称为几周，而不是几个月，当然不是几年。” 他淡化了这些问题，将其描述为仅仅是调整机器的问题，“使其能够准确地射出炮弹，而不是稍微偏离一点”。

第二天，梅斯基特的一名工人拍摄了一台机器的工作情况，该机器旨在开始为贝壳提供完美光滑的鼻子；相反，它把金属破碎成类似软冰淇淋漩涡的东西。

同样在 9 月，沃穆斯部长在一次会议上吹捧了陆军炮兵的发展，他说：“实现这一目标的部分原因是我们在梅斯基特开设的全新工厂。” 一个月后，一名陆军合同官员向通用动力公司发送了一封对其在该设施表现的担忧信。 一个月后，该公司错过了陆军完成第一条生产线的最后期限。 （沃穆斯拒绝发表评论。）

尽管如此，Gezen 在 2024 年秋季仍然保持乐观。 据一位熟悉他想法的人士透露，他认为梅斯基特的问题只是延误，并且已经制定了解决这些问题的计划。 “如果 Firat 犯了某件事，它就不想看到事情的真相，”一位前同事说。 他“有不想听坏消息的倾向”。 通用动力公司宣布 Gezen 于 2025 年 1 月退役。 一些业内人士认为，他被驱逐的部分原因是梅斯基特。 （格森否认了这一点，但拒绝接受正式采访。）

截止日期提前和公众评论乐观的局面一直持续到唐纳德·特朗普总统的第二届政府。 2025年4月，通用动力公司错过了第二条生产线的竣工日期。 同月，诺瓦科维奇再次告诉投资者：“随着德克萨斯州弹丸工厂的开业，我们正在迅速提高弹药产能和产量。” 两个月后，该公司再次错过了首篇文章测试。

随着失败的增加，陆军办公室里弥漫着一种沮丧的感觉。 该部门组建了一个团队来评估工厂的情况，该团队编写的报告对问题的解决缺乏信心。 最终，据当时的一份国防贸易出版物报道，2025 年 6 月，陆军告诉通用动力公司，它正在考虑终止该工厂的合同授予。 两个月后，该部门下令工厂三条生产线中的两条停工。

但陆军并没有单方面终止授予合同。 一位前陆军官员告诉 ProPublica：“通过法律体系来终止违约可能需要数年时间，因为通用动力公司不会接受这一点。” “除了律师，没有人会赢。”

这不会是特朗普政府对通用动力公司的最后一次慷慨之举。 根据监察长的报告，2025 年 12 月，政府向该公司支付了 2630 万美元的“进度款”，用于梅斯基特的第二条和第三条生产线，尽管两条生产线都从未生产过可用的外壳。

新颖的解决方案

两个月前，通用动力公司发布的公告让人有一种似曾相识的感觉。 为了解决工厂的问题，该公司将与另一个闻所未闻的合作伙伴合作，承诺进行技术创新。 这次的解决方案是？ 人工智能。

通用动力公司和新公司 Deterrence 发布的新闻稿充满了技术商业术语。 两家公司写道，梅斯基特和其他通用动力工厂将增加“人工智能功能”和“智能和连接”。 “人工智能将生产设施转变为战略资产，”Deterrence 首席执行官在新闻稿中表示。 “我们正在构建能够实时学习、适应和扩展的自主制造系统。”

这些声明让前梅斯基特工人感到困惑。 “他们在说什么？ 没有什么可以学习、适应或扩展的，”一位人士说道。 “都坏了。”

通用动力公司正在这样做，尽管它用斯克兰顿使用的传统机器取代了大部分雷普康设备。 人工智能将如何从数十年历史的技术中夺取奇迹尚不清楚。 但通用动力公司告诉投资者，预计将于明年开始生产，陆军告诉监察长，每月将生产 20,000 枚炮弹。

与雷普康相比，威慑或许是一个更不传统的选择。 威慑中心成立仅三年，从未获得国防部合同。 它的网站没有表明它曾经帮助制造过任何东西。 其三位创始人此前没有任何国防经验。 其中一位在特斯拉工作；另外两人创建了一家初创公司，使人们能够使用智能手机锁定和解锁建筑物。 威慑没有回应置评请求。

通用动力公司还承诺为该项目投入2亿美元。 对于一家去年营收超过 500 亿美元、并为首席执行官诺瓦科维奇提供超过 2500 万美元薪酬的公司来说，这只是一笔小数目。 （与此同时，该公司暂时解雇了大部分梅斯基特工人。）

陆军表示不会在该项目上投入更多资金，但它并没有拒绝通用动力公司。 陆军告诉 ProPublica，自从陆军一年前关闭梅斯基特的两条生产线以来，通用动力军械和战术系统公司已获得总计 25 亿美元的合同。 （该部门表示，这是为了“独特的生产线和关键的国防需求”，与梅斯基特无关。）

在收到陆军价值 4.35 亿美元的无投标合同后，Repkon 的美国分公司目前正在建设一家 TNT 工厂。 TNT 是 155 毫米炮弹中的主要炸药填充物。 Repkon 土耳其公司首席执行官共同创立了这家美国公司，该公司最初名为 Repkon USA。 3月，更名为Paligen Technologies。 一些人将此解读为试图与梅斯基特灾难拉开距离。 Paligen 告诉 ProPublica，它和 Repkon 是“不同且完全独立的公司”。 Repkon Turkey 没有回应置评请求。

主要决策者似乎都同意的一件事是，他们绝对不应该受到责备。 通用动力公司前高管格曾告诉 ProPublica，该公司和陆军没有做错任何事。 今年五月，格曾在华盛顿特区一处繁华地段的公寓门口进行了一次简短的谈话，他仍然保持着阳光般的乐观态度。 Repkon 设备是一个不错的选择，而且可能仍然是一个不错的选择，他一手拿着一杯冰咖啡，另一只手约束着一只大狗。 无论如何，他补充道，“这是最快的选择。”

陆军前采购负责人布什也拒绝接受采访，他曾向记者保证增加火炮生产“不会出现重大延误”。 在五月的一次简短谈话中，他从位于弗吉尼亚州北部的半掩的前门向外望去，告诉ProPublica：“所有这一切都是通过适当的程序完成的。”

其他不愿透露姓名的参与人员相互指责：白宫要求太多太快，雷普康和通用动力公司承诺过多，陆军没有进行尽职调查，而国会则包办了整件事。

一位前陆军官员在 6 月份告诉 ProPublica，尽管美国为提高 155 毫米弹药产量而进行的其他投资取得了较好的效果，但美国仍距离承诺每月生产 10 万枚炮弹还差得很远。 这位官员表示，乌克兰仍然需要这些炮弹，但注意力再次转移。 在中东，特朗普政府在与伊朗的战争中迅速烧毁了其他弹药。 特朗普官员现在呼吁加快这些地区的产量。

这位官员表示：“传统弹药又重新被搁置。” “现在一切都与拦截器、导弹有关。”

通用动力公司也为这些产品制造组件。
